description.value: The Ramada Plaza Prince George bills itself as the city's largest hotel, occupying a prominent spot on historic George Street in the heart of downtown Prince George. Guests can choose from renovated Premiere Guest Rooms to Jacuzzi Suites and Presidential Suites, with an indoor pool, whirlpool, fitness centre, business centre, and an onsite Starbucks. Its central downtown location places touring cyclists within easy walking distance of the regional conference centre, government offices, and a noted local restaurant scene.

address.value: 444 George Street, Prince George, BC V2L 1R6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and rich. Phone (250-563-0055), address (444 George Street, Prince George, BC V2L 1R6), and website all corroborate OSM values; however, OSM email (reservations@) differs from website's main contact (guestservices@). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, pump, tools, or bike wash anywhere on the site. Wi-Fi is confirmed via website ('free high-speed wifi') and OSM (internet_access=wlan, fee=no). In-room safe with a charging outlet confirms device charging. Website references 'neighborhood's thriving local restaurant scene,' confirming nearby evening food.
concerns: OSM email (reservations@ramadaprincegeorge.com) differs from the website's primary contact email (guestservices@ramadaprincegeorge.com); OSM value should be updated.
OSM name is 'Ramada Hotel Downtown' but the website consistently uses 'Ramada Plaza Prince George'; official_name in OSM is 'Ramada by Wyndham'.
Cornerstone Kitchen & Lounge (on-site restaurant) is currently closed for renovations per website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a large, operational downtown hotel well-suited to touring cyclists by location, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is confirmed or denied by the website. Direct outreach is needed to determine whether the property can meet WWC minimum requirements before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Pet-friendly rooms on the 4th floor include 'complimentary covered gated parking,' suggesting a secured parking structure exists, which could potentially accommodate bikes — but this is not stated and should be confirmed directly with the property.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states: 'explore our neighborhood's thriving local restaurant scene, including our own Cornerstone Kitchen & Lounge (currently closed for renovations).'

Device charging.detail: Premiere Guest Rooms feature an in-room safe with an internal outlet capable of charging devices up to a 17" laptop
